risks.risk: Compatibility risk: these mounts/brackets may not fit the buyer’s engine/model (different bolt patterns/lengths).
risks.proof: A clear photo of the exact part(s) with any stamped numbers/vehicle/engine code, plus a photo showing bolt-hole spacing/ruler measurement for each mount.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as generic/possibly wrong-fit used mounts (worst case: buyer may need returns or replacement), so value is low.

risks.risk: Condition risk: rubber may be cracked/soft or metal brackets may be bent; rust suggests wear.
risks.proof: Close-up photos of the rubber sections (cracks, separation from metal) and the mounting holes/edges; plus a short clip showing the rubber flex (no tearing).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as worn/unknown condition used mounts (worst case: not reliable for immediate use).

risks.risk: Completeness risk: photo appears to show multiple different pieces; seller may not be supplying all required components for a working installation.
risks.proof: A laid-out inventory photo showing exactly what is included (count each mount/bracket), and confirmation of what is missing (bolts, nuts, brackets).
risks.if_unproven: Priced as incomplete/uncertain set (worst case: buyer receives only some pieces).

risks.risk: Hidden damage risk: some parts may have fractures not visible from this angle.
risks.proof: Photos from multiple angles of each metal bracket (especially around welds/bolt bosses) and a close-up of any cracks.
risks.if_unproven: Priced as potentially damaged used parts (worst case: buyer may need welding/replacement).

proof_requests: Confirm the exact vehicle/engine the mounts fit (make/model/year or engine code) and show any stamped markings on the parts.
Provide close-up photos of each rubber mount (front/back) showing cracks, separation, and rust level.
Show bolt-hole pattern/measurements (or a ruler) for each mount/bracket so fitment can be checked.
List exactly what is included (number of mounts/brackets and whether bolts/nuts are included).
response.reason: The photo shows mixed used engine mounting/bracket parts, but the seller’s statement is unclear and the exact compatibility, completeness, and rubber/metal condition cannot be verified remotely from this single image.
